name: sandboxed-read-block
description: Stops permissions.blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories from forcing a prompt on Bash commands the sandbox already confines

verdict.title: Verdict for sandboxed commands
verdict.description: allow: run the command without any further check; ask: drop the read-block reason but still ask (in 2.1.289 that ask goes to the person, not the auto-mode classifier)
